001package org.clafer.collection;
002
003import java.lang.reflect.Array;
004import java.util.ArrayList;
005import java.util.HashSet;
006import java.util.List;
007import java.util.Set;
008import java.util.stream.Stream;
009import org.clafer.common.Check;
010
011/**
012 * A sum type. Does not allow nulls.
013 *
014 * @param <A> the type of left
015 * @param <B> the type of right
016 * @author jimmy
017 */
018public abstract class Either<A, B> {
019
020    public abstract boolean isLeft();
021
022    public abstract A getLeft();
023
024    public abstract boolean isRight();
025
026    public abstract B getRight();
027
028    public static <A, B> Either<A, B> left(A left) {
029        return new Left<>(Check.notNull(left));
030    }
031
032    public static <A, B> Either<A, B> right(B right) {
033        return new Right<>(Check.notNull(right));
034    }
035
036    public static <A, B> List<A> filterLeft(List<Either<A, B>> eithers) {
037        List<A> lefts = new ArrayList<>();
038        for (Either<A, B> either : eithers) {
039            if (either.isLeft()) {
040                lefts.add(either.getLeft());
041            }
042        }
043        return lefts;
044    }
045
046    public static <A, B> Set<A> filterLeft(Set<Either<A, B>> eithers) {
047        Set<A> lefts = new HashSet<>();
048        for (Either<A, B> either : eithers) {
049            if (either.isLeft()) {
050                lefts.add(either.getLeft());
051            }
052        }
053        return lefts;
054    }
055
056    @SafeVarargs
057    public static <A, B> A[] filterLeft(Either<A, B>[] eithers, A... array) {
058        List<A> lefts = new ArrayList<>();
059        for (Either<A, B> either : eithers) {
060            if (either.isLeft()) {
061                lefts.add(either.getLeft());
062            }
063        }
064        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
065        A[] to = array.length == lefts.size()
066                ? array
067                : (A[]) Array.newInstance(array.getClass().getComponentType(), lefts.size());
068        return lefts.toArray(to);
069    }
070
071    public static <A, B> List<B> filterRight(List<Either<A, B>> eithers) {
072        List<B> rights = new ArrayList<>();
073        for (Either<A, B> either : eithers) {
074            if (either.isRight()) {
075                rights.add(either.getRight());
076            }
077        }
078        return rights;
079    }
080
081    @SafeVarargs
082    public static <A, B> B[] filterRight(Either<A, B>[] eithers, B... array) {
083        List<B> rights = new ArrayList<>();
084        for (Either<A, B> either : eithers) {
085            if (either.isRight()) {
086                rights.add(either.getRight());
087            }
088        }
089        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
090        B[] to = array.length == rights.size()
091                ? array
092                : (B[]) Array.newInstance(array.getClass().getComponentType(), rights.size());
093        return rights.toArray(to);
094    }
095
096    public static <A, B> Stream<B> filterRight(Stream<Either<A, B>> eithers) {
097        return eithers.filter(Either::isRight).map(Either::getRight);
098    }
099}
